events.title: Tupac Shakur's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot dead in Las Vegas at the age of 25.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 today. His music and message continue to resonate.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: We remember guitar icon Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: A true pioneer. Remembering Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84 today, and his unparalleled impact on music.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Classic
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us Abbey Road. What's your go-to track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th Birthday to The Pretenders' frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th Birthday to the legendary Oasis and Beady Eye frontman, Liam Gallagher, born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday Groove
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the iconic Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Release Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine The Message
angles.copy: 49 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity is as relevant as ever.

events.title: First iPod Release Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple dropped this game-changer. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic film franchise.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Theme
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! We're celebrating all things 007. What's your pick for the ultimate Bond theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music still inspires.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary comedian and actor, John Cleese, born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday Laughs
angles.copy: From Python to Fawlty Towers, the brilliant John Cleese turns 87 today! What's your favourite moment from a true comedy icon?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. So many tracks, so many moods. Which one's on repeat for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost the legendary Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. Forever a champion.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Rewind
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history! 61 years since The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. What's your favourite track from this era?

events.title: John Lennon's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world lost a musical legend, John Lennon, at the age of 40.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon. His music and message of peace live on.
